_rules: Each stage: waves_count waves; wave w spawns at t_s; item_index picks the stage theme items[] (stage_themes.json); count enemies in formation; mini_boss event spawns after ~60% of waves (wave script pauses until it dies); boss spawns when the last wave is cleared (after boss_after_s at the earliest). Spawn x lane: left=20%, center=50%, right=80% of 1280 px; line=row of count, v=V shape, column=stacked, zigzag=alternating x, pair=2 side by side. coin_wave=5: a gold coin drops once, first-clear stages only.
